interpretation.pearson_near_zero_reason: Score range is only 1.5 pts (3.5-5.0 on a 1-5 scale); correlation is sensitive to rank order, not absolute error. MAE and within-0.5 are more informative here.
interpretation.judge_validation_status: Self-consistency check only — same person built both judge and golden labels. Not validated against an independent annotator.
known_rubric_weaknesses: actionable axis rewards '?' or 'DM' even when asking a question is wrong (e.g. tweet 119291, already-resolved message)
grounded axis uses lexical overlap and cannot detect topically wrong grounding (e.g. tweet 119326, Music/WhatsApp reply to a freezing complaint)
